description: The grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the Shapley value across various positional categories for three different models. The horizontal axis displays the categories, ordered sequentially as L4+, L3, L2, L1, T, R1, R2, R3, and R4+, without an explicit axis label. The vertical axis represents the "Shapley value" on a linear scale, with a visible range from slightly below 0 to 80, and numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 20 (0, 20, 40, 60, 80). Horizontal grid lines extend from each tick mark across the plot area, and a small grey shaded rectangle is positioned on the vertical axis line just above the 40 mark. For each category on the horizontal axis, there is a group of three bars arranged side-by-side from left to right. According to the legend in the top right corner, these bars represent three models: mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and chLSTM (light green). All bars are outlined in black. The highest Shapley values for all three models occur in category T, where mBERT is approximately 59, XLM-R is approximately 54, and chLSTM reaches the chart's maximum at approximately 79. The values generally decrease as the categories move further away from T in either the L or R direction. The shortest bars are found in the outer categories, with chLSTM showing slightly negative values (dropping below the 0 line) in categories L4+, R2, R3, and R4+. For example, in category R3, mBERT is near 0, XLM-R is approximately 1, and chLSTM is approximately -1. The categories are not sorted by value but follow a specific alphanumeric sequence centered around T.
